evals.prompt: This React shop should let a Chrome agent filter dresses by size and occasion using in-page tools, not DOM scraping. Keep checkout as a human confirm step.
evals.expected_output: Feature-detected document.modelContext tools registered on the shop view, aborted on leave, JSON schemas for filter/show, and checkout left human-gated without toolautosubmit.
assertions: Uses feature-detected native registration with view cleanup and a separate execution cancellation policy; no production polyfill.
Tools reuse existing client filter/render logic and return JSON-serializable ids or counts.
Purchase or place-order is not silently executed from a tool.
Unsupported browsers still shop through the existing UI.
Checks the target browser contract before choosing executeTool arguments; does not probe alternate signatures by retrying mutations.

evals.prompt: Annotate our existing flight search form so a browser agent can fill origin, destination, and date. Do not auto-submit.
evals.expected_output: toolname, tooldescription, and toolparamdescription on the real form; no toolautosubmit; confirm-submit UX preserved.
assertions: The form remains a native HTML form with named fields.
toolautosubmit is omitted because the user asked not to auto-submit.
Field descriptions live on toolparamdescription, not a parallel agent-only tree.

evals.prompt: Make this repo agent-ready: write AGENTS.md and a project skill for how coding agents should run tests.
evals.expected_output: Handle the requested coding-agent guidance with agent-ready-this when available, without adding in-page WebMCP tools.
assertions: The result classifies the job as coding-agent rules, not an in-page WebMCP surface.
The result does not register browser tools for running unit tests.

evals.prompt: Audit the lifecycle of these page tools. Native WebMCP is unavailable here, but component tests can run.
evals.expected_output: A scoped lifecycle audit with tests where useful and an explicit native-execution gap.
assertions: Does not call successful feature detection or a test mock native verification.
Distinguishes unregistration from cancellation of pending execution.
Does not install a production polyfill or change browser flags to manufacture proof.
